title: F2 split restoration scan configuration
statement: For a natural number $k$, Boolean lists $w$ and $s$, and a natural number $j$, define a configuration of the specified machine on input $w$. Its state is $(0, [|w|<j])$, its input-head position is the position assigned to $w$ and $j$ by the split-position construction, and its output is empty. Every work-head position is $j$; the first work tape is the buffer encoding of $s$, and the remaining work tapes are given by the scratch-tape construction with parameters $|s|+1$ and $j$.
caveat: The supplied snippet does not include the definitions of the split-position, buffer-tape, or scratch-tape constructions, so their precise mathematical contents cannot be stated from the given information.
